Exercise: Butt Lift (Bridge)

Category:
strength

Exercise Type:
isolation

Force Type:
push

Difficulty Level:
beginner

Movement Patterns:

- hip_extension

Primary Muscles:

- glutes

Secondary Muscles:

- hamstrings

Equipment:

- bodyweight

Fatigue Score:
2

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
0.8

Energy Requirement:
ATP-PC system

Recovery Time:
1 hours

Goals:

- glute_strengthening
- hamstring_engagement

Contraindications:

- Recent lower back surgery or injury
- Severe osteoporosis

Exercise Variations:

- name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge, equipment: body only, secondaryMuscles: ['hamstrings']
- name: Glute Bridge with Dumbbell, equipment: dumbbell

Substitution Options:

- name: Glute Bridge with Resistance Band, equipment: resistance band
- name: Romanian Deadlift, primaryMuscles: ['hamstrings', 'glutes']

Instructions:

- Lie flat on the floor on your back with the hands by your side and your knees bent. Your feet should be placed around shoulder width. This will be your starting position.
- Pushing mainly with your heels, lift your hips off the floor while keeping your back straight. Breathe out as you perform this part of the motion and hold at the top for a second.
- Slowly go back to the starting position as you breathe in.
